root_cause: preflight pipes successful Make/compiler --version producers into head -1. Early reader exit can deliver SIGPIPE to the producer; pipefail makes preflight fail. The macOS arm64 job printed GNU Make 3.81 and exited 141 before remaining canonical gates.
fix: Drain each preflight version producer through sed -n 1p. Keep Make banner/status refusal and compiler nonzero status propagation.
